feature_brief.title: Normalize Text
feature_brief.description: Normalize one local UTF-8 text file with Python standard library only.
feature_brief.outcome: One local file yields normalized text or an evidenced deterministic error.
feature_brief.scope_in: Per-line edge whitespace and newline normalization; deterministic stdout and error behavior.
feature_brief.scope_out: Batch processing, network access, persistence, packaging, external dependencies.
